read.thesis: Q1 operating margin fell 730bp to 11.2% and FY26 revenue and EPS guidance were cut, with Americas comps down 6% constant dollar; the supply-side signals (inventory units down 4%) are the only constructive datapoint.

triggers.label: FY26 EPS cut to $10.95-11.15
triggers.quote: For 2026, the Company now expects net revenue to be in the range of $11.000 billion to $11.150 billion, representing a decline of 1% to 0%.

triggers.label: Gross margin down 410bp to 54.2%
triggers.quote: Gross profit decreased 3% to $1.3 billion and gross margin decreased 410 basis points to 54.2%.

triggers.label: Americas comps -6% constant dollar
triggers.quote: Americas comparable sales decreased 5%, or 6% on a constant dollar basis.

triggers.label: Inventory units down 4% YoY
triggers.quote: On a unit basis, inventories decreased 4%.

guidance.quote: For 2026, the Company now expects net revenue to be in the range of $11.000 billion to $11.150 billion
Diluted earnings per share are now expected to be in the range of $10.95 to $11.15 for the year.
the Company expects net revenue to be in the range of $2.450 billion to $2.475 billion
Diluted earnings per share are expected to be in the range of $1.76 to $1.81 for the quarter.

red_flags.label: Guidance cut and business repositioning
red_flags.quote: we have been navigating headwinds that have led us to adjust our outlook for the full year

red_flags.label: Operating margin down 730bp
red_flags.quote: operating margin decreased 730 basis points to 11.2%
